newsitem.title: UK: French Connection sees improved profit.
newsitem.headline: French Connection sees improved profit.

text.p: Retail and wholesale and fashion clothing company French Connection Group Plc said on Thursday that it expects pretax profits for the year will be above market expectations and in the region of six million stg.
"We are pleased with the trading performance in the second half and particularly the contribution made by our retail division," chairman David Bernstein said in a statement.
Shares in the company had surged 40-1/2p to 310p by 0930 GMT on the back of the announcement.

It said that turnover for the year ended January 31, 1997 shows a 17 percent increase on the previous year. Like for like sales for the year at outlets French Connection and Nicole Farhi rose by over 20 percent.
It made pretax profits of 3.43 million stg for the year to January 31, 1996. Results are due in April.
